probes.What are human teeth made of?:
Human teeth are complex, multi-layered structures. While they may look like solid white stones, they are actually made of several different types of tissues, each with a specific function.

The three primary components of a tooth are **enamel, dentin, and cementum**, along with a living core called the **pulp**.

### 1. Enamel (The Outer Shell)
Enamel is the hard, white outer layer of the crown (the visible part of the tooth). It is the hardest substance in the human body—even harder than bone.
